title: fix(release): the stable cut folds each prerelease section into the stable section instead of copying it
body:
<!-- claude-projects-attribution: {"github_login":"os-steve"} -->
_Requested by **Steve** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_01FdL1XeUyvVNxLreh3F4Qi9?thread=cmsg_01FdL1XeUyvVNxLreh3F4Qi9DjkzyES5iJcSWAVHScrQBe)_
Fixes #26079
Clause-②: no
Metadata-protocol: none
Ruling-ref: 6417011624 (batch #397 item 3, letter A′, maintainer 「同意」)

## What this does

On the stable cut out of pre mode (`changeset pre exit`, then `pnpm run version`), the changelog generator now **folds** every `X.Y.Z-next.N` section of the cycle into the `X.Y.Z` section instead of leaving it as a second copy below it. Today that cut re-applies every changeset the prereleases consumed, so the stable section repeats each prerelease section verbatim (18.0.0 left `packages/spec/CHANGELOG.md` with about 4,076 duplicated long lines).

Ruled scope, kept: only `scripts/changeset-changelog.mjs` changes behaviour; its pins go into the self-test CI already runs for it (`node scripts/release-pending-publish.mjs --self-test`, lint.yml), the file surface the seat widened on the claim. ⛔ No `files` change in any `package.json` — `CHANGELOG.md` keeps shipping (AGENTS.md, Documentation Guardrails). ⛔ No existing CHANGELOG text is rewritten by this PR, and the generator never touches an older cycle (#25919 A 「存量不横扫」). No workflow change, no new gate.

## Timing — when the fold runs, and on what

The generator API (`getReleaseLine` / `getDependencyReleaseLine`) hands out one line at a time and is told neither the package nor the version, and `@changesets/apply-release-plan` writes every `CHANGELOG.md` only after all lines are generated. So:

1. **Armed on the first generated line**, and only when `.changeset/pre.json` says `"mode": "exit"` (the stable cut; the version pass itself deletes that file later). An rc cut (`mode: "pre"`) and a normal cut (no `pre.json`) arm nothing.
2. **Snapshot at arming:** each tracked `*CHANGELOG.md` whose top `## VERSION` is a prerelease (read from the first 64 KiB only).
3. **Run when the `changeset version` process exits 0** (a `process.once('exit')` handler; a failed version pass folds nothing). For each snapshotted file whose top is now a new stable section sitting directly above the old top, the prerelease sections between that stable section and the next stable one below are dropped — each one only if every changeset entry it carries is found in the new stable section (compared without the commit prefix). Dependency-bump entries (`Updated dependencies`, `pkg@X.Y.Z-next.N`) are superseded by the stable section's own. A section holding an entry the stable section does not reproduce (amended in place by a docs PR, say) stays, with a `::warning::` naming it.

What may fold is fixed by the file as it stood before the cut, never by a version guess, so every stable section and every older cycle's prerelease sections are kept byte for byte. One plain line reports the count: `changeset-changelog: the stable cut folded N prerelease section(s) in M CHANGELOG(s) into their stable section.`

## Evidence

- `node scripts/release-pending-publish.mjs --self-test` at `2f44043a`: `✓ release-pending-publish self-test: 136 cases across 34 batteries pass.` Three new batteries (floor 31 → 34): a prerelease section folds (4 cases); the stable section is kept whole, and so is every older cycle, and a section with an entry the stable section lacks stays (5 cases); armed only on an exit-mode cut, for the files whose top was a prerelease, folded after the write (3 cases).
- **End to end through the real CLI** (`@changesets/cli` 3.0.3, throwaway repo, two fixed packages, this generator): `pre enter next` → version (`1.2.0-next.0`) → version (`1.2.0-next.1`) → `pre exit` → version (`1.2.0`). Result: `## 1.2.0` (all three entries, each naming the commit that added its changeset), then the untouched `## 1.1.0` / `## 1.1.0-next.0`; the run printed `folded 4 prerelease section(s) in 2 CHANGELOG(s)`. The rc cuts in between folded nothing.
- **Control leg**, same history, the generator at `origin/main` `95294be3`: the stable cut leaves 5 sections (`1.2.0`, `1.2.0-next.1`, `1.2.0-next.0`, `1.1.0`, `1.1.0-next.0`), 37 + 36 lines, against 3 sections and 23 + 22 lines with this change.

## Confidence gap from the card

No downstream tooling reads an installed CHANGELOG's prerelease section:
- This repo: the CHANGELOG readers (`check:release-notes`, `check:release-page-status`, `check-release-section-coverage.mjs`) read `## N.x.y` headings for majors / GA versions; the stable heading the fold keeps is what they count.
- `objectstack-ai/hotcrm` at `9464673`: no script reads `node_modules/@objectstack/*/CHANGELOG.md`; one code comment cites the `17.0.0` heading of installed CHANGELOGs, a stable heading.
- `objectstack-ai/cloud`: NOT MEASURED — not readable from this session.

## Gates

`node scripts/pm/dispatch-gates.mjs --commands --repo objectstack-ai/objectstack` at `2f44043a` derives 33 commands; all 33 exit 0, and `--ran` reconciles `33 derived, 33 run, 0 NOT-MEASURED, 0 UNRUN`. CI families outside the derivation are read from this PR's check-runs.

## Acceptance notes

- The fold applies at the next stable cut out of pre mode; nothing in the tree changes on merge. Rollback is reverting this PR before that cut.
- `skip-changeset`: the diff is repository tooling under `scripts/`, which no package's `files` ships.
